name: ticket-flow
description: Take a Jira ticket from start to Accepted: write and verify the code, review teammates' PRs, fix review comments and QA bugs, deploy moonbeam to staging and prod, and merge single, combined and stacked PRs. Moves the Jira tickets at each step and learns from every review comment and QA bug. Uses gh and the aikit CLI.

plugins.name: ticket-flow
plugins.description: Thirteen skills. thread: runs each command of a long-lived thread in a fresh agent. start: does a ticket end to end and asks before the commit and PR. ticket-verify: adversarial QA in the browser or API, a review against the repo's past PR comments, and a PDF report for Jira. pr-review: reviews teammates' PRs with a high bar and the repo's past lessons. fix: fixes review comments and QA bugs and redeploys only when needed. deploy-staging and deploy-prod: deploy moonbeam and move the tickets. prod-handoff: moves tickets to On Prod, tells QA and starts the merge watch. merge: merges single, combined and stacked PRs and cleans up. catch-up, jira-sync, mcp-merge, and refresh-patterns.
